input.body: ## Step to reproduce 1. Select any existing thought or create a new one 2. Tap Fire/ Delete button on the top toolbar 3. Tap and hold existing thought to trigger Command Center 4. Tap Fire/ Delete button on the Command Center ## Current behavior Deleting from top toolbar says "Permanently deleted [thought name]" Deleting from Command Center says "Deleted 1 thought." ## Expected behavior Both of the alerts should have a consistent copy. @raineorshine, please help with the expected copy.
input.title: Inconsistent alert copy when deleting thought from Toolbar vs Command Center
